section_summary.extract_value: This is a Measures section describing the assessment instruments used in the study. The study assessed body appreciation using the 10-item BAS-2 scale, weight discrepancy using the Photographic Figure Rating Scale (PFRS) for women only, self-esteem using the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (RSES), and life satisfaction using the Satisfaction With Life Scale (SWLS). All measures used Likert-type rating scales with varying point ranges.
section_summary.evidence_source: The entire Measures section describes the instruments: BAS-2 (5-point scale), PFRS (10-point scale for women only), RSES (4-point scale, 9 items after removal), and SWLS (5-point scale, 5 items).
